{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Big government undermines federalism through more than 1,100 grants-in-aid programs that consume more than one-sixth of the federal budget for matters that should be the exclusive responsibility of the states.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Money originating from state taxpayers is returned to the states through grants-in-aid programs, usually greatly reduced, with myriad strings attached.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Grants-in-aid programs turn state and local elected officials into agents of the federal government.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The requirement of matching funds that comes with federal grants transforms recipients into appendages of the Washington bureaucracy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for Congress to help a Republican president reduce and ultimately eliminate the system of conditioned grants.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for state and local taxpayers to decide for themselves what is best for their own communities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact and any other scheme to abolish or distort the procedures of the Electoral College.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"An unconstitutional effort to impose National Popular Vote would be a grave threat to the federal system and a guarantee of corruption, as every ballot box in every state would offer a chance to steal the presidency.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Urging state legislatures that have voted for the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact to rescind their approval.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
